additions.name: room
additions.short: Project journal: signed rooms, notes, decisions and runs

additions.name: available
additions.short: List Meet recordings that are not yet imported into the vault

help.text:
List Meet recordings that are not yet imported into the vault

Reads the Meet store ($XDG_DATA_HOME/symmeet, default ~/.local/share/symmeet) and
lists recordings that no vault meeting note refers to. A missing or empty store
is an empty list. Nothing is modified.

Usage:
  symdesk meeting available [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for available

Global Flags:
      --json            output in JSON format
      --output string   output format: text|json|yaml (--json is shorthand for --output json)
      --vault string    override document vault path (the Markdown workspace; unrelated to symvault)

additions.name: import
additions.short: Import a Meet recording into the vault as a meeting note

help.text:
Import a Meet recording into the vault as a meeting note

Creates meetings/meeting-<id>.md from the recording's manifest, transcript and
speaker labels. A recording that is already imported is left untouched
(use 'meeting refresh --apply' to update its transcript). The recording is only read.

Usage:
  symdesk meeting import <meeting-id> [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for import

Global Flags:
      --json            output in JSON format
      --output string   output format: text|json|yaml (--json is shorthand for --output json)
      --vault string    override document vault path (the Markdown workspace; unrelated to symvault)

additions.name: refresh
additions.short: Preview (or apply) a re-export of a meeting note's transcript

help.text:
Preview (or apply) a re-export of a meeting note's transcript

Re-derives the transcript of an imported meeting note from its recording and
shows the difference. Only the block between the symmeet-transcript markers is
replaced, and only with --apply; frontmatter and notes outside the block stay.

Usage:
  symdesk meeting refresh <vault-note> [flags]

Flags:
      --apply   write the refreshed transcript instead of only previewing it
  -h, --help    help for refresh

Global Flags:
      --json            output in JSON format
      --output string   output format: text|json|yaml (--json is shorthand for --output json)
      --vault string    override document vault path (the Markdown workspace; unrelated to symvault)

help.text:
List the time-coded transcript segments of a meeting note's recording

help.text:
List the speakers of a meeting note's recording with their labels
